title: A lesson (lessons/<id>/lesson.yaml)
description: What of the toolkit a lesson teaches: its techniques. The toolkit (under-test) holds each technique's rules, in techniques/<id>/technique.yaml; this repo says which lessons teach each one, and its checks keep the catalogue, the lessons index and every link into the toolkit in step with these files. A lesson with an example names at least one technique, and every lesson its level. Words follow GLOSSARY.md.

id.description: The lesson's folder name, under lessons/.

title.description: The lesson's name, as its README and the lessons index give it.

techniques.description: Ids of the toolkit techniques this lesson teaches: folder names under the toolkit's techniques/.

level.description: How hard the technique is to learn, whatever the library: beginner (one idea, usable the same day, inside one test), intermediate (a judgement about what to check, or a change to how code is built or wired), advanced (changes how you think about correctness, spans teams or systems, or needs care to read its results).

buildsOn.description: Lessons worth doing first: their folder names, under lessons/.
